name: Readability Score
description: Measures readability consistency across content segments.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform readability levels
mechanism: Divides content into segments and measures complexity variance. AI text maintains consistent readability throughout, unlike human writing which naturally varies.
source: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
